\subsection*{Space Complexity --- Savitch ARM --- Setup: Results}

\begin{theorem}[Exponent-loading execution]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.ld_run}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.ld_run}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LogProg.AReach, Complexity.LogProg.AReach.refl, Complexity.LogProg.GuardLe, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.A, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.St, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.St.Bd, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.St.toV, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.step_of, Complexity.LogProg.astep, Complexity.LogProg.reach_of_eq}
\difficulty{4}
Let $E,B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathcal{O}$ be a Boolean-valued function on four indices
and finite Boolean words, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean word. Suppose
$k,j\in\mathbb{N}$, $j<E+1$, $j+k=E$, and $\mathrm{st}$ is a state with
$\mathrm{st}.X=j$, every register at most $B$, $E\le B$, and $\mathrm{st}.P+1\le B$.
Then the program $A_E$ has a finite run from the configuration with label
$\mathrm{ld}(j)$, registers $\mathrm{st}$, and no answer to the configuration with label
$\mathrm{pw}$, $X=E$, $P=\mathrm{st}.P+1$, every other register unchanged, and no
answer. Every configuration strictly before the final one satisfies the guard for $A_E$,
input $x$, and bound $B$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Power loop execution]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.pw_run}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.pw_run}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LogProg.AReach, Complexity.LogProg.AReach.refl, Complexity.LogProg.AReach.trans, Complexity.LogProg.GuardLe, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.A, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.St, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.St.Bd, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.St.toV, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mul_run, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mvExit, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.step_of, Complexity.LogProg.astep, Complexity.LogProg.reach_of_eq}
\difficulty{5}
Fix natural numbers $E$ and $B$, an oracle that assigns a Boolean answer to each of four
deciders and each Boolean word, and an input Boolean word $x$. For every natural number
$j$ and every state $st$ of the eighteen-register machine, suppose the exponent counter
is $X=j$, the loop counter and scratch registers satisfy $C=T=Z=0$, every register is at
most $B$, $1\le a$, and $P a^j\le B$. Then the machine starting at the power-loop
instruction, with register values given by $st$ and no answer recorded, reaches the copy
routine that sets the window radius, with $X=0$, $P=P_{st}a_{st}^j$, all other registers
unchanged, and no answer recorded. Every configuration strictly before that endpoint
satisfies the guard that the machine’s instruction precondition holds and every register
is at most $B$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Initialized register state]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.setSt}

\leanok

For natural numbers $s$ and $w$, define a register state in which every register is zero
except the window radius, which is $s$, the code width, which is $w$, and the code
bound, which is $2^w$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Savitch Procedure Setup Run]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.setup_run}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.setup_run}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LogProg.AReach, Complexity.LogProg.AReach.mono, Complexity.LogProg.AReach.trans, Complexity.LogProg.GuardLe, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.A, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.St.toV, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.St.zero, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.cont, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.cpDst, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.cpExit, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.cpSrc, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.cp_run, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.ld_run, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mul_run, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mvDst, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mvExit, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mvSrc, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mv_run, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.pw_run, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.rn, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.setSt, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.shExit, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.shReg, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.sh_run, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.step_of, Complexity.LogProg.astep, Complexity.LogProg.inputLength_loop, Complexity.LogProg.reach_of_eq, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{5}
Let $E$ be a natural number with $1\le E$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, let $B$ be
a natural number, and let $\mathrm{orc}$ be a Boolean oracle with four query types.
Suppose that for every natural number $k\le |x|$, query type $0$ on the encoding of $x$
and the binary word for $k$ returns true exactly when $k<|x|$, and suppose
$2^{(|x|+2)^{2E}}\le B$. The register program has a finite run from its scan state with
all registers zero and no answer to its outer-search state with window radius
$(|x|+2)^E$, code width $(|x|+2)^{2E}$, and code bound $2^{(|x|+2)^{2E}}$, with all
other registers zero and no answer. Every configuration before the final one satisfies
the guard that the instruction meets its stated preconditions and every register value
is at most $B$.
\end{theorem}
